author: Ceij-Cathy Holmberg-Schrampfer
text: Make sure you are using the 90 day option on the GMI, AND have at least 90% of the time active sensor.

author: Abby Kyriakoutsakos Marrazzo
text: An A1c is not the same as GMI. The Libre cannot calculate a blood test since it doesn’t use blood as its source.
